architecture.spacingPolicy: Evidence sections, inner cards, headings, rails, and dialog controls consume component or semantic tokens only.
architecture.mediaPolicy: Decision crops reuse the same DOM artifact renderer as the evidence gallery and add no duplicate image request.

components.contract: Sticky reserved row; Back and Close never overlap metadata or scroll away.
Section padding and inner-card padding are intentionally distinct and responsive.
Non-interactive contextual crop from the shared artifact model; no duplicate CTA.
Centered when idle; sticky only with a query and only within the matcher workspace.

releaseGates: all four routes styled and reachable
